meta.notes: Hand-authored scene skeletons; first line = location, second line = shift, title = core. Two main actors as Entities, plus Goal and Obstacle.

scenes.titleCore: THE BISHOP MEETS THE FOREMAN — The Architecture of Meaning
scenes.locationLine: On the outskirts of an ancient city, a sprawling labyrinth of twisting alleyways, modern boulevards, and haphazard extensions, two figures stand amidst a dusty construction site.
scenes.shiftLine: The ground is littered with building stones: blocks, pillars, slabs, and beams.
scenes.goal: Clarify meaning as use in language-games.
scenes.obstacle: Augustinian referential model that reifies meaning as object.
scenes.notes: Location = ancient city outskirts; shift = construction site full of slabs; core = Bishop vs Foreman debate.

scenes.titleCore: THE SCRIBE MEETS THE GOLEM — The Procedural Turn
scenes.locationLine: In a stark, brightly lit void, there exists a floating table.
scenes.shiftLine: Upon it sits a collection of childish things: a red cube, a blue pyramid, a green box.
scenes.goal: Show that procedural, model-based language understanding (the Golem / SHRDLU) is superior to pure syntax.
scenes.obstacle: Modular generative grammar that isolates syntax from semantics and world models.
scenes.notes: Location = void with floating table; shift = introduction of colored blocks; core = Scribe vs Golem procedural turn.

scenes.titleCore: THE NAVIGATOR MEETS THE CARTOGRAPHER — The Map of Grammar
scenes.locationLine: The forest of Language is dense.
scenes.shiftLine: It is a tangled thicket of words, recursive vines, and deep roots of meaning; two explorers stand at the edge, preparing to chart a path through.
scenes.goal: Show grammar as a procedural navigation of choices (PROGRAMMAR/Systemic Grammar) rather than a pure deep-structure generation system.
scenes.obstacle: Transformational generative model that insists on deep-structure trees and inverse transformations before interpretation, causing combinatorial explosion.
scenes.notes: Location = forest of Language; shift = explorers preparing to chart a path; core = Navigator vs Cartographer, grammar as program vs map.

scenes.titleCore: THE ANATOMIST MEETS THE ARCHITECT — The Design of the Self
scenes.locationLine: In the dusty wings of the Grand Theater of Being, where the costumes of history hang in endless rows, two figures stand over a sleeping actor.
scenes.shiftLine: The actor is dressed in the elaborate, gilded silks of a Javanese dancer.
scenes.goal: Show culture as necessary extragenetic software that completes an unfinished human brain, making particularity constitutive of being human.
scenes.obstacle: Enlightenment stratigraphic view that treats culture as removable costume hiding a universal human core (Consensus Gentium).
scenes.notes: Location = dusty wings of the Grand Theater of Being; shift = Javanese dancer costume; core = Anatomist vs Architect, culture as software not clothing.
